strategic_narratives.title: Location grid is a long-tail LOCAL play — suburb course demand is near-zero
strategic_narratives.summary: Only 6/23 suburbs register any measured course search (Geelong 40, Werribee 30, Dandenong 20, Bendigo/Frankston/Pakenham 10); 17/23 are zero. The 69-keyword grid (analyst-approved, keep-all-23) captures high-intent local '[course] {suburb}' queries + low competition, NOT volume. Real demand is city-level (the 5 general) and online. SET CLIENT EXPECTATIONS: location pages build slowly; measure by local rankings + enquiries, not traffic. Build genuine local landing pages (campus access, transport, local placement partners) — not thin doorways — to avoid a doorway-page penalty across 69 near-duplicate pages.

strategic_narratives.title: AI Overviews dominate course SERPs (80%)
strategic_narratives.summary: 64/80 probed course queries trigger an AI Overview, suppressing organic CTR. Every page must be built for AI-citation: clear qualification facts, structured data (Course/FAQ schema), and answers to the 256 available PAA questions. Ranking #1 organically no longer guarantees the click.

strategic_narratives.title: National qualification terms are unwinnable for DA 7 (government-TAFE wall)
strategic_narratives.summary: Bare terms (certificate iii in individual support 18,100; diploma of community services 9,900) show tempting low DataForSEO KD, but the SERPs are held by government TAFEs (tafeqld 56x, tafensw 49x; DA 41-54) + AI Overviews. All 5 general keywords are deliberately Melbourne-qualified to face reachable rivals (itac DA14, laurus DA18). Revisit the online-national terms (childcare course online 1,000/KD2; diploma of community services online 1,300/KD3; cert 3 aged care online 590/KD3) as DA grows — they are the strongest FUTURE general package.
